knownFailures.step: of many writers racing for one lease, exactly one wins
knownFailures.note: src/index.ts:172 awaits request.arrayBuffer() between its check and its insert, and workerd does not hold other requests across that await. Measured on wrangler dev and Orange, 10 trials each: 8 winners in every trial, on both. The README claim that writes cannot interleave does not hold on workerd either.
